title: Silverleaf band personnel
summary: Willie J. names the trumpet, leader, trombone, bass and drums of the Silverleaf band.

story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Who else was in the Silverleaf band who played trumpet?
I believe Mipolite Charles was playing the trumpet at the time. That's right. And Mr. Baptiste, Albert Baptiste was the leader. Who did he play? He played violin.

I think we, at the time I think we had Paul Benn. No, he was a boy from up the country there and he played around. We had Paul Benn and Jimmie Johnson was playing the bass in that band. And let's see, I can't think of some of those other guys. Oh yeah, I believe Lil' Kato was playing drums.
I think we had a big role in the band. After you finished the boat job, what did you do then?
